preconditions.description: The number of games T must be between 1 and 100.
Each hidden number X must be between 1 and 10^9.
Each query Q must be between 1 and 10^18.

postconditions.description: The answer ans must be within an absolute error of 7 or a relative error of 0.5 compared to the actual number of divisors d.
The output must start with '!' followed by the answer ans.

invariants.description: The number of gcd responses received must not exceed 22.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= gcd_response <= X for gcd_response in gcd_responses)
invariants.description: All gcd responses must be between 1 and X.
